defect_a_promotion_not_transactional.problem: promote_staged_rows renamed rows one-by-one with no crash-recovery manifest
defect_a_promotion_not_transactional.correction: PREDICTION_PROMOTION_TRANSACTION_<execution_id>.json (READY_TO_PROMOTE -> COMPLETE) written before any row is moved, binding row IDs and staged artifact hashes; recovery validates and resumes file-renames only, zero model inference
defect_a_promotion_not_transactional.test_proof: crash simulated after 1 and after 2 of a 3-row fake matrix's promotions recovers to the identical final lock with zero inference calls

defect_b_metadata_authority_violation.problem: _score called resolve_target_matrix (V1) to build row_meta, violating the post-E1-closure sole-authority rule
defect_b_metadata_authority_violation.correction: _row_meta_from_lockset builds row_meta solely from the frozen TARGET_PREDICTION_LOCK.json entries; resolve_target_matrix no longer imported or called from _score
defect_b_metadata_authority_violation.test_proof: poisoning resolve_target_matrix to raise does not affect _score's outcome

defect_c_wrong_reveal_code_commit.problem: first_authorized_reveal_code_commit was set to the E1 prediction_execution_code_commit
defect_c_wrong_reveal_code_commit.correction: build_label_reveal binds prediction_execution_code_commit (unchanged, from lockset) and first_authorized_reveal_code_commit (fresh git HEAD via a new local subprocess helper, no detector.checkpoint import) separately
defect_c_wrong_reveal_code_commit.test_proof: the two commit fields differ when the underlying commits differ; assert_no_training_capability still passes

defect_d_target_access_state_in_real_art.problem: no explicit access_state field on the label reveal or the final score result
defect_d_target_access_state_in_real_art.correction: both now carry access_state with all-true booleans and counts=1; counts never increment on idempotent reuse
defect_d_target_access_state_in_real_art.test_proof: reveal_target_labels called twice leaves target_label_access_count == 1 both times

defect_e_label_tamper_not_validated.correction: the validator re-hashes the CURRENT label file against the frozen reveal's SHA-256 and recomputes reveal_identity, only when a reveal already exists on disk
defect_e_label_tamper_not_validated.test_proof: tampering with label bytes after reveal is detected; no code path hashes label bytes before a reveal exists

defect_f_per_row_score_identity.problem: score_one_row returned the raw scoring.score() payload with no identity binding
defect_f_per_row_score_identity.correction: every per-row score file wraps metrics in a self-hashing envelope (score_artifact_identity); validator checks exactly-24/no-extras/per-file-hash/cross-reference
defect_f_per_row_score_identity.test_proof: a one-byte tamper to any per-row file is detected; missing/extra files are detected

defect_g_final_result_provenance.problem: EXPLORATORY_TARGET_SCORE_RESULT.json lacked scoring_execution_code_commit, target_label_artifact_sha256, target_feature_package_identity, per-row identities
defect_g_final_result_provenance.correction: all four added; score_result_identity hashes the complete extended result

defect_h_scoring_not_crash_recoverable.problem: E2 scoring had no staging/transaction layer; a crash risked rescoring or a second label reopen
defect_h_scoring_not_crash_recoverable.correction: .score_staging/<execution_id>/ + SCORE_PROMOTION_TRANSACTION_<execution_id>.json, mirroring defect A; recovery reads the existing TARGET_LABEL_REVEAL.json directly and reconstructs scored_rows from disk
defect_h_scoring_not_crash_recoverable.test_proof: crash simulated after 1 of 24 rows promoted recovers to the identical final result with zero rescoring, zero reveal re-derivation, zero label re-load
